blocks.prompt:
1 What is the atmosphere? Describe its major, minor and trace components, and state how the atmosphere is divided into layers. (4 marks)
(Atmosphere kya hai? Is ke major, minor aur trace components bayan karein, aur batayein atmosphere ko layers mein kaise taqseem kiya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Atmosphere: zameen ke gird mukhtalif gases ka aik kurra (sphere).

Components:
• Major: nitrogen (78.00%) aur oxygen (21.01%).
• Minor: argon (0.93%) aur carbon dioxide (0.04%).
• Trace: methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton aur xenon.

Layers: atmosphere ki chaar alag layers hain jo bulandi ke saath temperature ki tabdeeli se tay hoti hain: troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere aur thermosphere.

book_ref.quote: Trace components are methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, and xenon.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the four layers of the atmosphere, giving the height and temperature range of each and one main feature. (4 marks)
(Atmosphere ki chaar layers bayan karein; har aik ki bulandi, temperature aur aik khaas baat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar layers bulandi ke saath temperature ki tabdeeli se tay hoti hain:

book_ref.quote: It extends to a height of about 50 – 85 km from the ground.

rows: Sab se neechi aur ghani; bari gases; barish, bijli, toofan
Ozone UV jazb karti hai; darmiyani hisse mein ozone layer
Atmosphere ka sab se thanda hissa
Bulandi ke saath barhta hai; upar 500 °C se 2000 °C ya zyada
Taaqatwar UV aur X-rays jazb kar ke garam

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 14.1 mein mesosphere 50-80 km likha hai jab ke text 85 km kehta hai; yahan text wala 50-85 km aur 85-600 km liya gaya hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain, with equations, how ozone is broken down and formed in the three regions of the stratosphere. (4 marks)
(Equations ke saath samjhayein ke stratosphere ke teen hisson mein ozone kaise toot'ti aur banti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Stratosphere (12-50 km; temperature -58 °C se -2 °C tak barhta hai) Suraj ki UV shuaon ki taqseem ke mutabiq teen hisson mein hai.

1. Upper hissa: ozone taaqatwar UV jazb kar ke diatomic aur monoatomic oxygen mein toot jati hai:
O₃(g) → O₂(g) + O(g)   (hν)

2. Middle hissa: kam UV guzarti hai. Monoatomic aur diatomic oxygen mil kar ozone banate hain; yeh exothermic reaction hai aur is se ozone layer banti hai:
O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g)

3. Lower hissa: bohat kam UV, is liye monoatomic oxygen nahi milti aur ozone nahi banti.

book_ref.quote: The middle stratosphere has less ultraviolet radiations passing through it.

blocks.prompt:
4 What are air pollutants? Define primary and secondary pollutants with examples, and list the most important air pollutants. (4 marks)
(Air pollutants kya hain? Primary aur secondary pollutants ki misalon ke saath definition likhein aur sab se ahem pollutants ki fehrist dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pollutants: woh maadde (gases, liquids, solids) jo mahol ke liye nuqsan deh hain. Air pollutants primary aur secondary hote hain.

Primary: seedhe paida ya kharij hone wale, maslan volcano ki raakh, gaari ke dhuen ki CO.
Secondary: primary pollutants ke chemical reactions se bante hain, maslan photochemical smog ki ozone aur PAN.

Ahem pollutants:
• Carbon ke oxides (CO, CO₂)
• Nitrogen ke oxides (NO, NO₂) = NOₓ
• Sulphur ke oxides (SO₂, SO₃) = SOₓ
• Hydrocarbons (methane, ethane)
• Zameen ke qareeb ozone (O₃)
• CFCs
• PAHs
• POPs
• VOCs
• Particulate matter (PM)
• Heavy metals (Pb, Hg, Cd)

book_ref.quote: Air pollutants can be classified as primary and secondary.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the human-made sources of air pollution. How are they classified and which pollutants do they release? (4 marks)
(Hawai aaloodgi ke insani zariye bayan karein. In ki darja bandi kaise hoti hai aur yeh kaun se pollutants chhorte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Hawai aaloodgi ke do bare zariye hain: qudrati aur insani. Shehron mein zyada aaloodgi insani zariyon se aati hai.

Darja bandi:
• Mobile sources: gaariyan, truck, hawai jahaz, samandari engine.
• Point sources: factories, bijli ghar waghaira.

Pollutants:
• Gaariyon, factories aur bijli gharon mein coal, fuel oil aur natural gas jalne se CO₂, CO aur hydrocarbons (CH₄).
• Ghar mein lakri aur eenton ke bhattoon mein coal jalana bhi aaloodgi phelata hai.
• Factories aur bijli ghar SOₓ aur NOₓ; gaariyan CO, PM aur VOCs chhorti hain (14.8.1).

book_ref.quote: The combustion of fossil fuels (coal, fuel oils, and natural gas) in vehicle engines, factories and power plants produce

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the oxides of carbon and oxides of nitrogen as air pollutants, giving their formation equations and effects. (4 marks)
(Carbon aur nitrogen ke oxides ko air pollutants ke tor par bayan karein; banne ki equations aur asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carbon ke oxides:
• CO: zyada tar fossil fuels ke namukammal jalne se:
  2C(s) + O₂(g) → 2CO(g)
  Bohat zehreeli: haemoglobin se oxygen se zyada mazbooti se judti hai, oxygen ko saans se bahar kar ke dam ghontti hai. Zyada pressure wali oxygen se ilaj.
• CO₂: fossil fuels jalne se ahem greenhouse gas:
  C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g)
  Garmi qaid kar ke global warming laati hai.

Nitrogen ke oxides (NOₓ = NO aur NO₂): fossil fuels jalne se:
  N₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO(g)   (zyada temperature)
  2NO(g) + O₂ → 2NO₂
N₂O mitti aur samandar ke jaraseem, khaad aur sanati combustion se; ozone layer kam karti hai aur climate change barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: It binds blood hemoglobin more strongly than oxygen thus excluding oxygen from normal respiration.

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe oxides of sulphur, hydrocarbons and low-altitude ozone as air pollutants (sources and harmful effects). (4 marks)
(Sulphur ke oxides, hydrocarbons aur zameen ke qareeb ozone ko air pollutants ke tor par bayan karein (zariye aur nuqsanat).)
blocks.explanation:
Sulphur ke oxides (SOₓ = SO₂ aur SO₃):
• Zyada tar coal aur tel jalane se.
• Bukharat se mil kar acid rain banate hain jo ecosystem ko nuqsan deti hai; SO₂ acid deposition ka bara zariya.

Hydrocarbons:
• Qudrati: paude, jangal ki aag, volcano, seeps.
• Insani: fossil fuels ka namukammal jalna, tel ka phailao, sanati aur gaariyon ka dhuan; gaariyan sab se bara zariya.
• Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon pollutant.

Zameen ke qareeb ozone (O₃):
• Taaqatwar oxidizing agent; kam miqdaar mein ghair-zehreeli magar zyada miqdaar mein zehreeli.
• Insanon, paudon, rubber, kapre ke rang aur paint ko nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: There are two oxides of sulphur i.e., sulphur dioxide (SO₂) and sulphur trioxide (SO₃)

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain, with balanced equations, how chlorofluorocarbons destroy ozone in the stratosphere. Why can one CFC molecule destroy a very large number of ozone molecules? (4 marks)
(Balanced equations ke saath samjhayein ke CFCs stratosphere mein ozone kaise tabah karte hain. Aik CFC molecule bohat zyada ozone molecules kyun tabah kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ozone depletion: stratosphere mein ozone ki miqdaar ka kam hona. Yeh CFCs se hoti hai jo gas ya kam boiling point wale liquids hain aur aerosol propellant aur fridge/AC mein coolant ke tor par istemal hote hain.

Mechanism: CFCs stratosphere tak phail jate hain jahan UV unhein tor kar chlorine free radical (Cl•) azad karti hai:
CFCl₃ → CFCl₂ + Cl•   (UV)
Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂
ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂

Chain asar: aakhri qadam mein Cl• dobara banta hai jo agli O₃ torta hai. Doosra aur teesra qadam bar bar hote hain, is liye aik CFC molecule 100,000 tak ozone molecules tabah kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The formation of another chlorine free radical in the last step that can further break down another molecule of O₃.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein do ghaltiyan durust ki gayi hain (Book correction): UV se 'chloride' nahi balke chlorine free radical Cl• banta hai, aur teesra qadam ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ hai (chhapa hua ClO• + O₂ → Cl• + O₂ balanced nahi).

blocks.prompt:
9 What is particulate matter? Describe its composition, sources and effects on human health. (4 marks)
(Particulate matter kya hai? Is ki banawat, zariye aur insani sehat par asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: PM hawa mein tairte barik thos zarre, maye qatre ya dono hain; hawa mein mu'allaq sara dust, dhuan aur dhund.

Banawat: acids, organic chemicals, metals aur mitti ya dust ke zarre. Is mein 2.5 se 10.0 micrometre qutr ke dust, mitti, soot aur dhuan shamil hain.

Zariye:
• Qudrati: volcano, aag, mitti ke toofan, hawa mein samandari namak; pollen, spores aur janwaron ke zarre.
• Insani: mashini aur sanati combustion, gaariyon ka dhuan, tambaku ka dhuan.

Sehat par asar: saans ki nalyon mein soojan aur jalan se asthma aur bronchitis; dil ke daure ka khatra (soojan, nalyon ko nuqsan, high blood pressure); lambe arse mein lung cancer.

book_ref.quote: Particulate matter (PM) is all the dust, smoke, and haze particles suspended in ambient air.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the impact of human activities on the atmosphere with reference to burning of fossil fuels and deforestation. (4 marks)
(Fossil fuels jalane aur jangal kaatne ke hawale se atmosphere par insani sargarmiyon ka asar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Insani sargarmiyan, khaas tor par fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna, atmosphere par gehra asar daalti hain; in se climate change, aaloodgi, kharab hawa aur doosre masail paida hote hain.

1. Fossil fuels jalana:
• Maujooda climate change ki bunyadi wajah; ecosystem badalta aur sehat ke masail paida karta hai.
• Greenhouse gases, hawai aaloodgi aur VOCs ke zariye asar.

2. Deforestation:
• Insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf ya kam karna; aalmi mausam ka bara masla.
• Jangal CO₂ jaisi GHGs jazb kar ke hawa saaf karte hain, in ka khatma climate change barhata hai.
• Doosre asraat: biodiversity ka khatma, mitti ki kharabi, paani ke cycle mein khalal.

book_ref.quote: These activities contribute to climate change, air pollution, poor air quality and other environmental issues.

blocks.prompt:
11 What is smog? Describe its composition and its two types. (4 marks)
(Smog kya hai? Is ki banawat aur do qismein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Smog: ghane dhundle pan wali hawai aaloodgi, zyada tar shehron mein; gaariyon, sanaton aur doosre zariyon ke dhuen se.

Banawat: barik dust ya soot, jame hue bukharat, zehreeli gases (SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO, CO₂), secondary pollutants jaise O₃, unburned hydrocarbons, VOCs aur PM 10-2.5 micron.

Qismein:

book_ref.quote: Smog is a type of air pollution typically characterized by a thick haze.

rows: Industrial, reducing ya London smog bhi kehte hain
Los Angeles smog bhi kehte hain
Hawa mein SOₓ ki ziyada miqdaar se
NOₓ, VOCs aur unburned hydrocarbons dhoop mein photochemical reactions karte hain
Secondary pollutants ozone aur PAN bante hain
Zyada khatarnak: dil ki tez dharkan, pneumonia, lung cancer tak

blocks.prompt:
12 Define the greenhouse effect and global warming. Explain how greenhouse gases keep the earth warm, and how their concentration affects global temperature. (4 marks)
(Greenhouse effect aur global warming ki definition likhein. Samjhayein greenhouse gases zameen ko kaise garam rakhti hain aur in ki miqdaar aalmi temperature par kya asar daalti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Greenhouse effect: greenhouse gases ke kambal jaise asar se zameen ki satah ka barhta hua garam hona; yeh gases ke infrared jazb karne par mabni hai.

Global warming: insani sargarmiyon, khaas tor par fossil fuels ki GHGs se, zameen ke ausat satahi temperature mein lamba izafa; yeh aalmi satah ka masla hai.

Amal:
• CO₂ aur bukharat chhoti wavelength ki dhoop guzarne dete hain magar garam zameen ki lambi wavelength ki garmi wapas bhejte hain.
• Din mein Suraj ki infrared garmi zameen garam karti hai. Raat ko zameen garmi khala mein chhorti hai magar kuch gases garmi qaid kar ke nuqsan rokti hain.

Miqdaar ka asar: CO₂ aur doosri GHGs (maslan N₂O, CFCs) jitni zyada, garmi ka jazb aur aalmi temperature ka izafa utna zyada.

book_ref.quote: Some atmospheric gases trap the heat from the sun, thus, preventing the loss of heat.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 14.5 mein NO₂ ko greenhouse gas likha gaya hai; durust gas N₂O (nitrous oxide) hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the Air Quality Index? Give the AQI values with their levels of health concern and colours, and state who is at high risk when the AQI is hazardous. (4 marks)
(Air Quality Index kya hai? AQI ki qeematein, health concern ke darje aur rang likhein, aur batayein hazardous AQI par kaun zyada khatre mein hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Air quality AQI se naapi jati hai, jo kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki miqdaar ka paimana hai. Achhi hawa saaf hoti hai; kharab hawa dhundli aur sehat aur mahol ke liye khatarnak hoti hai.

AQI ke darje (Table 14.2) neeche hain. 50 se kam AQI achha hai: bahar rehna mehfooz. 300 se zyada AQI hazardous hai.

Zyada khatre wale: 18 se kam umar ke bachay, 65 se zyada umar ke log, dil aur phephron ke purane mareez; bahar kaam karne wale lambe wasta ki wajah se.

book_ref.quote: Air quality is measured in terms of Air Quality Index (AQI).

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the main health risks associated with air pollution. (4 marks)
(Hawai aaloodgi se wabasta sehat ke bare khatraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hawai aaloodgi sehat ke liye bare khatraat rakhti hai. Asraat acute ya chronic ho sakte hain aur pollutant ki qisam aur miqdaar, muddat aur shakhsi kamzori par munhasir hain.

1. Saans ki bimariyan: ozone, PM aur NO₂ asthma ki alamaat aur daure barhate hain; lamba wasta purani khansi aur pneumonia jaisi infections.

2. Dil aur nalyon ki bimariyan: PM soojan, nalyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure se dil ke daure aur aakhir stroke ka khatra barhata hai.

3. Cancer: PM aur carcinogenic compounds (maslan benzene) se lamba wasta lung cancer.

4. Tolidi aur nashonuma ke asraat: mard aur aurat ki fertility ko nuqsan; waqt se pehle paidaish aur bachon ki nashonuma ke masail.

book_ref.quote: Prolonged exposure to certain air pollutants especially particulate matter (PM)

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the methods and instruments used to measure and monitor air quality. (4 marks)
(Air quality naapne aur monitor karne ke tareeqe aur aalaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Air quality ki monitoring mein mukhtalif tareeqe mil kar PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃ aur VOCs ki miqdaar naapte hain.

Direct pemaish ke tareeqe:
1. CEMS: sanati jagahon par CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs aur PM monitor karta hai.
2. AQMS: sensors aur analysers wale qaim stations jo foran pollutants naapte hain; shehri aur sanati ilaqon mein.
3. Remote sensing: sensors wale satellites bare raqbe par pollutants naap kar ilaqai aur aalmi data dete hain.

Nephelometer: AQI naapne ka aala; dust, dhuan, dhund aur fumes jaise PM monitor karta hai. Isay photometer bhi kehte hain; yeh zarraat se bikharne wali kul roshni naap kar unhein pehchanta hai.

book_ref.quote: Measuring and monitoring air quality involves a combination of methods and techniques

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the steps of an experiment to test a hypothesis about air quality, taking traffic hours as an example. (4 marks)
(Traffic ke auqaat ki misaal le kar air quality ke hypothesis ko jaanchne wale tajurbe ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Air quality ke hypothesis ko jaanchne ke liye mohtaat mansooba bandi, data jama karna aur analysis zaroori hai.

1. Hypothesis: pehle hypothesis banaya jata hai, maslan 'shehron mein PM 2.5 aur NO₂ rush ke auqaat mein ghair-rush se zyada hote hain.' Isay din ke mukhtalif auqaat mein data jama kar ke jaancha jata hai.

2. Tajurbe ka design: variables aur data jama karne ka tareeqa tay hota hai. Masroof sarkein aur rihaishi ilaqe chune jate hain.

3. Data jama karna: rush aur ghair-rush auqaat ka traffic data jama kar ke muqabla; qabil-e-aitmaad aalaat.

4. Analysis aur tashreeh: data se hypothesis ke sach ya ghalat hone ki tasdeeq; nataij ki tashreeh aur nateeja, taa ke air quality behtar karne ki hikmat-e-amli bane.

book_ref.quote: The design of experiments to test hypothesis about air quality involves careful planning, data collection and analysis.

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the technologies used to control the emission of air pollutants from vehicles and industries. (4 marks)
(Gaariyon aur sanaton se air pollutants ka ikhraj rokne wali technologies bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hawai aaloodgi kam karne ke liye kai technologies hain. Chapter chaar bayan karta hai:

1. Catalytic convertor: gaariyon ke engine NOₓ, CO aur unburnt hydrocarbons chhorte hain. Catalytic convertor inhein beziyaan maaddon mein badalta hai: CO → CO₂ (oxidation); NOₓ → N₂ (reduction); hydrocarbons → CO₂ aur H₂O.

2. DPF: jadeed diesel engines mein PM kam karne ke liye; exhaust se soot ke zarre pakar kar jama karta hai.

3. SCR: diesel engines mein; NOₓ ko N₂ mein reduce aur CO aur hydrocarbons ko CO₂ aur bukharat mein oxidize karta hai; catalysts TiO₂, zeolites.

4. Scrubbers: liquids (maslan paani) se sanati exhaust ki SO₂ aur PM nikalte hain; PM, SO₂, HCl, NH₃ aur VOCs control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The following five types of technologies we can be used to control emission of air pollutants.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab 'five types' kehti hai magar sirf chaar (catalytic convertor, DPF, SCR, scrubbers) bayan karti hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
18 Name the laws related to air pollution in Pakistan and describe the measures taken to control air pollution. (4 marks)
(Pakistan mein hawai aaloodgi se mutaliq qawaneen ke naam likhein aur aaloodgi rokne ki tadabeer bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qawaneen:
• Pakistan Environmental Protection Act (PEPA 1997)
• National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS), PEPA 1997 ke tehat
• Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012

Tadabeer:
1. Vehicle emission standard: gaariyon ki aaloodgi kam; CNG aur LPG jaise saaf eendhan, fuel quality par sticker.
2. Industrial emission control: sanaton ka ikhraj kam aur saaf tareeqa-e-paidawar.
3. Awami aagahi: aaloodgi ke zariye aur asraat batana; public transport, carpooling, cycling aur paidal chalna.
4. Urban planning: green belts aur parks; traffic ka rash kam karna.
5. Smog control: khaas tor par sardiyon mein; faslon ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi; smog towers.
6. Kachra khuli aag mein jalane par pabandi.
7. Kam sulphur wala diesel.

book_ref.quote: Through these regulations and measures, Pakistan aims to improve air quality

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein NEQS ko 'Natural' Environmental Quality Standard likha hai; durust 'National' hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
19 Discuss the economic, social and political issues related to air pollution. (4 marks)
(Hawai aaloodgi se mutaliq maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail par bahas karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hawai aaloodgi bari maashi laagat aur samaji aur siyasi masail ka sabab hai.

Maashi masail:
• Bimari aur ghair haaziri se mazdooron ki paidawar kam.
• Faslon ka nuqsan, paidawar kam, khane ki qeematein zyada.
• Acid rain se imaraton, pulon aur infrastructure ko nuqsan.

Samaji masail:
• Bachay, boorhe aur kam aamdani wale zyada mutasir.
• Lamba wasta zindagi ka mayaar aur samaji sehat girata hai.
• Shadeed aaloodgi se hijrat aur samaji be-ghari.

Siyasi masail:
• Siyasi aur maashi mafadaat se qawaneen nafiz karna mushkil.
• Aaloodgi sarhad paar jati hai; bain-ul-aqwami taawun zaroori.
• Sakht hukmrani sanati taraqqi sust kar ke siyasi jhagre la sakti hai; socio-economic aur technology ka tawazun chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Air pollution and bad air quality is responsible for huge economic costs
